scripts.register_sim:
def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    acc = inputs['X'] & ((1<<32)-1)
    mask = (1<<32)-1
    nrounds = round(inputs['K'])
    for _ in range(nrounds):
        acc ^= (acc << 13) & mask
        acc ^= acc >> 7
        acc ^= (acc << 15) & mask
        acc &= mask
    return acc
